metadata.title: Unbound stars hold the key to young star cluster history

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's "unbound stars" are unbound from their young star cluster after gas expulsion, defined through total energy (e.g., T:p1-b8, T:p3-b15), not unbound from the Milky Way. No individual Galactic-unbound candidate is identified or followed up; the analyzed observational samples are unnamed cluster-member populations, while the named entities are clusters or subcluster groups rather than individual stars (e.g., T:p9-b9, T:p10-b6, T:p10-b10).
